quarterly_data.quarter: Jabil press release: Jabil Expands Manufacturing Capacity in India (06-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Jabil opened a new factory in Pune (MIDC industrial zone, Maharashtra), inaugurated on 16 June 2026 following an MoU with the Maharashtra government. Jabil's India footprint has grown from 500,000 square feet to 1.2 million square feet over the past year and regional headcount from 5,000 to almost 11,000 employees; in India Jabil serves telecommunications, AI cloud data centres, automotive and digital commerce.
